expected_behavior: Relation reachability requires at least one traversed edge: an empty relation does not make a node reachable from itself, while an explicit self-loop does.
test_patch:
diff --git a/rust/fsl-runtime/tests/reviewgraphen_generated_calibration_16.rs b/rust/fsl-runtime/tests/reviewgraphen_generated_calibration_16.rs
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/rust/fsl-runtime/tests/reviewgraphen_generated_calibration_16.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};
+
+use fsl_core::{FsResolver, FslValue, KernelExpr, build_model, parse_kernel_source};
+use fsl_runtime::eval;
+
+#[test]
+fn reviewgraphen_generated_regression() {
+    let kernel = parse_kernel_source(
+        "spec Reachability { state { ready: Bool } init { ready = false } }",
+        &FsResolver::new("."),
+    )
+    .expect("parse model");
+    let model = build_model(kernel).expect("build model");
+    let expression = KernelExpr::TernaryNamed {
+        name: "rel_reachable".to_owned(),
+        first: Box::new(KernelExpr::Var("edges".to_owned())),
+        second: Box::new(KernelExpr::Num(0)),
+        third: Box::new(KernelExpr::Num(0)),
+    };
+    let mut state = BTreeMap::from([(
+        "edges".to_owned(),
+        FslValue::Relation(BTreeSet::new()),
+    )]);
+    let mut bindings = BTreeMap::new();
+
+    assert_eq!(
+        eval(
+            &expression,
+            &state,
+            &mut bindings,
+            &model,
+            None,
+        )
+        .expect("evaluate empty relation"),
+        FslValue::Bool(false)
+    );
+
+    state.insert(
+        "edges".to_owned(),
+        FslValue::Relation(BTreeSet::from([(FslValue::Int(0), FslValue::Int(0))])),
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        eval(
+            &expression,
+            &state,
+            &mut bindings,
+            &model,
+            None,
+        )
+        .expect("evaluate self-loop"),
+        FslValue::Bool(true)
+    );
+}
